REFERRAL LETTER - BLOOD & MARROW TRANSPLANT PROGRAM
Cobalt Ridge Cancer Center - Hematology / Oncology 410 Alder Street, Suite 5, Greenville, SC 29601 Tel (864) 555-0120 Fax (864) 555-0121
March 10, 2088
To: Transplant Coordinator, Piedmont Marrow Institute Re: Juniper K. Early, DOB 02/19/2023, MRN CR-771204
Dear Colleagues,
- Thank you for seeing this 65 year old woman with multiple myeloma (diagnosed December 2087, admitted 12/30/2087) for evaluation for autologous stem cell transplant. - Response to induction: very good partial response, per our last review. - PMH: ischemic heart disease with stent January 2073 (on clopidogrel, metoprolol, simvastatin), prediabetes, long-standing anaemia (on iron since 2051), obesity, a miscarriage in 2045. - She is a widow. Her husband Will Early died in 2084. She goes by "June" and bristles at "Mrs. Early" - she says "early is what I never am, I am always late" (her joke, not a typo). - Daughter Nova Early-Pike is the main support and drives; son Twelve Early (legal name Alexander Early, "Twelve" since high school football) lives in Denver, CO. - Dental clearance outstanding (tooth loss April 2083), seen by Dr. Halo Brandt.
Dear Dr. [NAME]: [template - never replaced]
Could you also advise on housing: she rents from Mr. Tolliver (Tolliver Properties) and he wants a note re: the stairs.
With thanks,
Tre Vasquez, MD Medical Oncology, Cobalt Ridge Cancer Center Electronically signed 03/10/2088 17:42 cc: Apple Nakamura, RN navigator, fax (864) 555-0133
